description: Mission Accomplished! <name>, your successful re-engineering of the cauldrons is a tremendous victory for us! Let all within my presence hear: for service to the Kingdom of Stormwind and to the Alliance above and beyond the call of duty - in the face of overwhelming odds and incredible danger, might I add - I give <name> this, and I extend upon him our undying gratitude as a true hero of the Alliance. Cheers, I say!
name: Mission Accomplished!
